github_owner.label: GitHub owner (user or organization) that owns the watched repos

github_login.label: Agent's GitHub login (pull request author match)
github_login.description: Agent_view scope only — a shared login would fan the same PR out across views.

github_token.label: GitHub personal access token (encrypted at rest; toolbox-only)
github_token.description: Agent_view scope only. bootstrap() resolves DEFAULT-scope obscure config in the cron process and would decrypt the token there.

repo_allowlist.label: Watched repo names, bare — no owner/ prefix (comma-separated; empty blocks all)
repo_allowlist.description: Agent_view scope only — see github_login. Names only, e.g. "agento,agento-docs": the owner comes from github_owner, so an "owner/repo" entry matches nothing.

poll_top.label: Max open agent-authored PRs handled per repo per poll (<=100)
